 Open Main Menu Miami Welcomes Back ESPN College GameDay, ACC Huddle
 Football November 20, 2026 College GameDay Returns to Coral Gables
 College GameDay Pit Rules » Parking Info » ESPN’s iconic college football pregame show College GameDay Built by the Home Depot will broadcast live from the University of Miami’s Lakeside Patio this Saturday, November 21, from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. The event is free and open to the public. 
 The three-hour show, which debuted in 1987 and has been broadcasting on location from college campuses across the country since 1993, will serve as a prelude to the seventh-ranked Hurricanes’ matchup against Virginia Tech Saturday night at Hard Rock Stadium. 
 College GameDay’s main stage will be set up  on the north end of the patio , between the Donna E. Shalala Student Center and the Norman A. Whitten University Center Pool.
 For the second consecutive season, ESPN’s College GameDay returns to Miami for a Hurricanes game, following last year’s visit for Miami’s matchup against Florida. This marks the show’s 10th visit for a Miami game and third trip to campus. The Hurricanes boast an 8-1 record in the previous nine games featuring College GameDay.
 In addition to College GameDay, ACC Network will broadcast ACC PM on the university’s Foote Green from 4-5 p.m. Friday and its pregame show ACC Huddle live from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. on Saturday.
 ESPN College GameDay & ACC Huddle Schedule of Events 
 5 a.m. – Line Opens
 6:30 a.m. – Pit Opens
 9 a.m. – ESPN College GameDay Begins Live Broadcast
 10 a.m.   – ACC Huddle Live Broadcast
 11:45 a.m. – ESPN College GameDay Guest Picker Appearance (to be announced)
 All times Eastern.
 Parking Information
 FREE parking will be available for all fans attending ESPN College GameDay on the University of Miami's Coral Gables campus. Visitors are encouraged to park in one of the following pink garages on campus:
 Pavia Parking Garage: 5615 Pavia Street, Coral Gables, FL 33146 
 Levante Parking Garage: 5501 Merrick St, Coral Gables, FL 33146 
 Click here for a map of the University of Miami's Coral Gables campus 
 Parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Fans should follow posted signage and directions from parking personnel upon arrival.
 TIMELINE OF EVENTS 
The day begins at 5 a.m. with the opening of the entry line, followed by Café Grooves' Sunrise DJ Set at 6 a.m. and the pit opening at 6:30 a.m. The Kids Zone, food trucks and fan activations open at 8 a.m., leading into College GameDay live at 9 a.m. and ACC Huddle at 10 a.m.
 The morning's festivities will culminate with special guest picker Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson at 11:45 a.m.
 The event is free and open to the public , with giveaways taking place throughout the morning. Fans are encouraged to arrive early and join the celebration of Miami Hurricanes football!
 SUPPORT THE #HEISMEN BY ARRIVING EARLY FOR A SPECIAL GIVEAWAY! 
 Hurricanes fans attending ESPN's College GameDay on Saturday, Nov. 21, will have the opportunity to receive an exclusive Miami football Heisman graphic T-shirt. 
 The first 1,000 fans in the pit will receive a limited-edition shirt featuring Hurricanes standouts Darian Mensah and Malachi Toney. The exclusive design celebrates Miami's Heisman Trophy campaign and is available only while supplies last. 
 Fans are encouraged to arrive early to secure their spot in the pit and take advantage of this special giveaway. 
 Fans who attend the live broadcast should expect to follow the ESPN “Pit Rules.” 
 Fans entering the pit will be screened and wanded by security.
 No bags, backpacks or purses permitted in the pit.
 No offensive, vulgar, inappropriate or solicitation signage will be allowed (i.e., no political, religious, or .com, .org, .net signage).
 No signs or flags on a stick/pole, etc.
 No pens, pencils, markers or dry erase boards.
 No food or drinks.
 Throwing of objects is prohibited.
